How to configure YouTube Studio

1. Open YouTube Studio and enable live streaming on your channel.
2. Prepare a live event, choose a reusable stream key, set Public visibility and specify whether the audience is made for kids.
3. Select that key in SpikeStream.
4. Before each match, check the destination event and its visibility in Studio. Test how your channel handles subsequent streams: the initial setup does not guarantee they will all be public.
